messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — multiple pod OOMs + packet loss detected in cluster-prod-rack-42. Severity: P1. Affected service: inference-serving. Auto-escalation to on-call. (rule: serving-runtime/oom + network/packetloss)
alice_oncall: I'm on it. seeing elevated 5xx from model-serving-route /v1/generate. Metrics: 5xx rate spiking ~12% over baseline, p95 latency 2.5s -> 6s. :rotating_light:
ben_runtime: pulling logs now. early signs show repeated CUDA OOMs on pod inference-worker-7 and retries causing retries pile-up. also kernel RDMA timeouts in dmesg.
cindy_sre: tagging networking. @greg_network can you check fabric health across rack-42 -> rack-43? suspect IB link flaps after the midnight maintenance window.
greg_network: on it. running ibstat + rdma link stats. will also check switch counters. can you share pod/node list?
alice_oncall: here: ```
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep inference-worker
inference-worker-5   Running   2/2  4d    10.10.42.15   node-prod-42a
inference-worker-6   CrashLoopBackOff 0/2  1h  10.10.42.16   node-prod-42b
inference-worker-7   OOMKilled 0/2  45m 10.10.42.17   node-prod-42b
inference-worker-8   Running  2/2  3d    10.10.42.18   node-prod-43a
```
alice_oncall: note multiple pods on node-prod-42b failing.
ben_runtime: logs from inference-worker-7:
```
2026-03-14T02:11:02Z inference serving: start request id=... model=gpt-small
2026-03-14T02:11:02Z runtime: allocate KV cache size 1.2GB
2026-03-14T02:11:03Z runtime: CUDA ERROR: out of memory (cudaMalloc failed)
2026-03-14T02:11:03Z runtime: aborting request id=... code=OOM
```
ben_runtime: also seeing RDMA kernel warnings:
```
[ 2345.678901] mlx5_core 0000:86:00.0: IB QP 0x123: error on packet RX: timed out
[ 2345.679012] rdma: mlx5: RQ timed out, resetting QP
```
cindy_sre: greg, anything from switch side? counters, retransmits, port flaps?
greg_network: switch shows heavy retransmit counters on port connected to node-prod-42b: >150k input errors, ECN marks high. running mtr between nodes shows intermittent packet loss ~3-5% for 30s windows. suspect bad cable or NIC hardware.
ivy_ops: can we quickly drain node-prod-42b to stop noisy retries and let serving fallback? plan: cordon -> drain with graceful termination for 60s, route traffic off node.
emma_support: notifying affected customers: a few enterprise tenants seeing elevated latency and some timeouts. starting a status page note: "Degraded — inference latency increased, retries ongoing". Will update customers once we have ETA.
ben_runtime: mitigation attempt 1: reduce batch size and disable auto-batching on pods on node-prod-42b to lower memory pressure. patch applied via rollout to subset.
alice_oncall: applying quick traffic steering: update route config to shift 30% traffic to dedicated fallback pool in us-east-1-d. command: ``redis-cli -x publish router.update '{"route":"/v1/generate","shift":30}'``
devops-bot: deploy started: rollout inference-runtime v2.3.8 -> canary 10% [deployment id: dpl-2233].
ben_runtime: after reducing batch size, still seeing intermittent OOMs on restart; suspect underlying NIC causing packet retransmit that forces retransmits and retry storms, increasing memory usage.
greg_network: confirmed pattern: port flaps coincide with CUDA OOM timestamps from logs. I'm going to schedule immediate port swap on top-of-rack switch and re-seat NIC on node-prod-42b. ETA ~12 min. paging hardware ops.
frank_prod: coordinating product comms. are any critical SLAs being breached? if >15% error we should prepare legacy failover and CS script. frank_prod to prep.
alice_oncall: starting graceful pod restarts on node-prod-42b: ``kubectl cordon node-prod-42b && kubectl drain node-prod-42b --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60``
ben_runtime: saved a heap profile before restart: ``/tmp/heap-1999998888.prof`` shows KV cache and persistent attention caches holding ~1.8GB combined per worker.
ben_runtime: temporarily lower KV cache size via env var REDWOOD_KV_CACHE_MAX=512MB and restart. will monitor.
greg_network: NIC reseat complete; switch port replaced and cables swapped. watching counters.
cindy_sre: node-prod-42b still shows RDMA resets but much reduced. retransmit counters dropping from 150k -> 200 in 5m.
alice_oncall: pods are gradually stabilizing. inference-worker-7 restarted and now running. OOM count down from 7/hour -> 0 in last 10m.
emma_support: status page updated: "Mitigating — routing shifted and node isolated. Customers may see intermittent degraded latency. Will post update in 30m." :white_check_mark:
ben_runtime: we still have two crashloops on older model-variants on node-prod-42a; looks config drift. I'm rolling a config sync.
devops-bot: rollout dpl-2233 succeeded: canary -> 30%.
alice_oncall: assessing impact: approx 18% of requests in last hour were retried; estimated customer-visible errors peaked at 12% and now down to ~1.5%. SLA breach avoided but close call. tagging incident P1 -> keep active for postmortem.
frank_prod: prepping customer notes and outreach for top 5 tenants. will coordinate with CS for credits if needed.
ben_runtime: follow-ups: (1) postmortem to include kernel RDMA logs, switch port counters, heap profiles; (2) add auto-node-cordon heuristic for repeated RDMA resets; (3) gate batch growth policy when packet loss >1%.
alice_oncall: handing off to next oncall: @cindy_sre taking night shift. summary: root cause likely flaky NIC/cable on node-prod-42b causing IB packetloss -> retransmits -> request retries -> memory pressure -> CUDA OOMs. mitigations: NIC reseat + port swap, cordon/drain node, reduce KV cache and batch size, route traffic to fallback pool. current status: stabilized, monitoring. next steps: postmortem, follow up with hw ops and network to check rack cabling, ensure firmware updates.
cindy_sre: thanks. I'm taking over. will monitor dashboards and run nightly checks. assign follow-ups to ben_runtime and greg_network. will update when postmortem doc is created.
ivy_ops: added action items to incident board: HW ticket #HW-3241, Network ticket #NET-7264, PMR for RDMA firmware version check.
alice_oncall: closing on-call handoff. feel free to @mention me if escalation needed. incident-bot: mark incident active -> monitoring.
incident-bot: Incident updated. channel pinned notes: "mitigated: node isolated, NIC swapped, KV cache reduced, traffic steered." All subsequent updates should be in thread.
